seller_comment:
Prepare to experience the pinnacle of Porsche performance with this exceptional 2022 911 GT3. Meticulously maintained and brimming with premium features, this sports car is poised to deliver an unparalleled driving experience.

- 4.0L H6 DOHC 24V LEV3-LEV160 502hp 6-Speed Manual RWD
- 14 City / 18 Hwy MPG
- Silver Exterior
- 3,402 Miles

Elevate your daily commute or weekend thrills with this 911 GT3's impressive capabilities:

- 8 Speakers
- Porsche Communication Management
- Four Wheel Independent Suspension
- Adaptive Suspension
- Rear Parking Camera
- Heated Front Seats
- and more...

This Porsche Approved Certified Pre-Owned vehicle comes with the ultimate peace of mind:

- Multipoint Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- $0 Warranty Deductible
- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History Report
- 24 Month/Unlimited Mile Limited Warranty
- Trip Interruption Reimbursement
